newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Development sets T$3/share dividend.
newsitem.headline: China Development sets T$3/share dividend.

text.p: Taiwan's China Development Corp, a venture capital and investment firm, said on Friday its board proposed a 1996 stock dividend of T$3 per share and planned a rights issue of T$4.21 billion.

The planned stock dividend and rights issue, if realised, will add a total capital of T$9.27 billion to the company, pushing its paid-in capital to T$26.11 billion from the current T$16.84 billion, China Development said in a statement.
The rights issue is aimed at improving its financial structure, paving the day for the firm's plan to convert into an industrial bank, it said.
The proposals need shareholders approval at a meeting slated for May 12, it said.
